instruction: Add all the songs from Aria Sterling that have been played over 990 times to my Spotify player queue.
notes: Single-app task (spotify). The username for spotify.login is the supervisor email obtained from supervisor.show_profile (modeled as (profile-known) plus the static (username-for spotify ...) fact); the password comes from supervisor.show_account_passwords. search_artists discovers the artist id (known-id), search_songs with query/artist_id/min_play_count=990 discovers the qualifying song set (matching-songs-found); only songs with the static (played-over ?s playcount-990) fact (i.e. play_count strictly > 990, the agent filters the >=990 search results) may be added to the queue, one add_to_queue call per song. The number of qualifying songs is only known at runtime, so the problem uses three placeholder song objects aria-song-1..3; instantiate as many as search_songs actually returns with play_count > 990 (and adjust the arity/distinctness constraints of supervisor-complete-task accordingly). supervisor-complete-task carries the song records only as non-API parameters so its lifted precondition equals the problem goal (all qualifying songs in-queue); it is called with no answer. The queue is only appended to (existing songs stay), matching the evaluation requiring old queue ids plus exactly the qualifying songs.
